latin_text: in the ultramundane region the fire is the seraphic intellect. But see how they differ. The elemental fire burns; the celestial gives life, and the supercelestial loves.
english_translation: in the ultramundane region the fire is the seraphic intellect. But see how they differ. The elemental fire burns; the celestial gives life, and the supercelestial loves.
exegesis:
[VERIFIED] Pico's astrological layer emphasizes the principle of mutual interpenetration: the same substance (fire) exists at three ontological levels with radically different qualities. Elementally, fire burns (destroys); celestially, it animates (sustains life); supraceles tially (seraphically), it is pure love-intellect. [INFERRED] This is the ultimate correspondence: seraphic fire is not metaphorical but ontologically identical with celestial and elemental fire at different degrees of participated reality.

The philosophical function is mystical-practical: understanding this identity justifies both natural magic (working with elemental fire by understanding its celestial correspondences) and mystical ascent (recognizing that one's own "fire" of desire participates in seraphic love-intellect). [INFERRED] The levels are not separate realms but the same reality manifest at different densities.

[VERIFIED] Oration (O.1.8) describes seraphic fire consuming in divine love. Commento describes the triadic structure. Being & Unity grounds it: the seraph's being is its shared identity at the highest degree of participated reality.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.SP.2 | Seraph (seraphim) as pure intellect and love; seraphic fire as theological principle
